purpose: Determine whether the same frozen participant-disjoint model can transfer from the 15 s / 7.5 s inference grid to the 15 s / 3 s inference grid without training, recalibration, threshold tuning, eventizer changes, or production changes.

previous_denominator_contract.approved_undecodable_skip_meaning: The frozen eligibility/raw-input contract explicitly skips an undecodable recording. The event remains in the fixed 234-event denominator with its existing A/B geometry result range, but it is excluded from the 232 exact-complete denominator. No missing support is imputed or repaired.

support_change_counts_on_fixed_234.rule: B minus A union coverage delta in milliseconds: positive improves, zero unchanged, negative worsens; no post-hoc minimum-effect threshold.

scope.grid_origin: preserve the existing recording/grid origin contract from the previous geometry diagnostic
scope.inference_population: all valid dense windows in the complete recording context, including background windows
scope.labels: evaluation and stratification only; never used to choose windows or control inference eventization

A.name: A_current_production_CandidateModel
A.class_balancing: explicit sample_weight: negative 1.0, positive 3.0; unsupervised rows excluded
A.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1 feature units; no scaler, selection, or resampling
A.probability_semantics: model-local probability-like ranking score; not assumed calibrated across estimators

N.name: N_temporal_probe_preregistered_bounded_nonlinear
N.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1 feature units; no scaler, selection, or resampling
N.probability_semantics: model-local probability-like ranking score; not assumed calibrated across estimators

participant_disjoint_mapping.model_binding: Each outer fold requires its already-trained model for the complementary training participants; no checkpoint or binding manifest is present in the worktree. This missing binding is a blocking condition.

score_selection_policy.inner_folds: participant-disjoint, min(4, outer-train participant count), seed 20260910
score_selection_policy.outer_threshold: fit-derived outer-train score quantile at the selected q; never selected using outer validation
score_selection_policy.threshold_provenance: embedded in the frozen decision-function probe report; these values are not sufficient to produce new B scores without the corresponding estimators

eventization_and_g1.matching: truth covered when any predicted interval for its participant has interval IoU > 0.25
eventization_and_g1.formal_gate: all five outer-fold pooled event recalls >= 0.90

diagnostics_if_gate_passed.primary_comparison: same fold model and same fold policy on A and B grids; A is replayed first
diagnostics_if_gate_passed.stopping_rule: run only A and B over the precommitted complete cohort in deterministic order; stop after the paired comparison

resource_budget.deterministic_order: all 232 exact-complete events with full recording context, then no expansion; the gate is checked before inference
resource_budget.partial_result_rule: If resources fail after a valid gate, mark PARTIAL and never select more events based on observed improvement. Current gate failure prevents any inference.

gate_and_stop.reason: Only historical 7.5 s scores and reports are available. New 3 s scores require calling the estimator, and no matched frozen fold estimators are serialized. Re-fitting would violate this diagnostic contract.
